lines.text:
What?!
Team Rocket is at Mt. Moon?\c
Huh?
I’m on the phone! Scram!
I really want a Pikachu, so I’m trading my\nClefairy for one.
I’m trading Pokémon with the girl next to me.\c\nI had two Pikachu, so I figured I might as well\ntrade one.

The Pewter City Gym Leader, Brock, is a
Rock-type Pokémon user!\c
Rock-type Pokémon are weak to Grass- and
Water-type moves.\c
If you don’t pay attention to type matchups, you
can’t defeat the Gym Leader.
There’s a flyer titled “Pokémon Center News.”

“Please be careful of a group of people calling
themselves Team Rocket.\c
“They have been known to steal people’s
Pokémon and use Pokémon for evil deeds.\c
“Please stay away from anyone who has a big R
on their clothing.\c
“To our readers who are strong Trainers, please
do not respond to any attempts they might make
to recruit you.”
